name: wtfail-mobile
description: Capacitor POC shell for wt.fail (Android, browser-OAuth + opaque bearer session).

scripts.build:web: cd .. && HEDGE_SITE= SITE_ORIGIN=https://wt.fail SITE_SLUG=wtfail SITE_TITLE="WT.Fail" SITE_LOGO="/public/wtfail.png" API_ORIGIN=https://wt.fail npm run build && rm -rf mobile/www && mkdir -p mobile/www && cp -r _site/* mobile/www/
scripts.add:android: cap add android && npm run patch:android
scripts.sync: cap sync android && npm run patch:android
scripts.patch:android: npm run deeplink && npm run gradle-jdk
scripts.dev:android: cap run android --live-reload --host $(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || hostname) --port 3030
